text_en: Let me sing for my beloved my love-song concerning his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.
text_cn: 我要为我的爱友讴唱一首论及他葡萄园的爱歌：我的爱友有一座葡萄园，位于肥沃的山冈上；

text_en: He dug it and cleared it of stones, and planted it with choice vines; he built a watchtower in the midst of it, and hewed out a wine vat in it; he expected it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
text_cn: 他翻掘了土地，除去了石块，栽上了精选的葡萄树，园中筑了一座守望台，又凿了一个榨酒池：原希望它结好葡萄，它反倒结了野葡萄。

text_en: And now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and people of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人啊！现在请你们在我与我葡萄园之间，判别是非：

text_en: What more was there to do for my vineyard that I have not done in it? When I expected it to yield grapes, why did it yield wild grapes?
text_cn: 我为我的葡萄园所能做的，还有什么没有做到？我原希望它结好葡萄，为什么却结了野葡萄？

text_en: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will remove its hedge, and it shall be devoured; I will break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down.
text_cn: 现在我要告诉你们，我将怎样对待我的葡萄园：我必撤去它的篱笆，让它被吞噬；拆毁它的围墙，让它受践踏；

text_en: I will make it a waste; it shall not be pruned or hoed, and it shall be overgrown with briers and thorns; I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
text_cn: 我要使他变成荒地，不再修剪，不再耕锄，荆棘和蒺(jí)藜(lí)将丛丛而生；并且我要命令云彩不再在它上降下时雨。

text_en: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the people of Judah are his pleasant planting; he expected justice, but saw bloodshed; righteousness, but heard a cry!
text_cn: 万军上主的葡萄园就是以色列家，而犹大人即是他钟爱的幼苗。他原希望正义，看，竟是流血；他原希望公平，看，却是冤声！

text_en: Ah, you who join house to house, who add field to field, until there is room for no one but you, and you are left to live alone in the midst of the land!
text_cn: 祸哉，你们这些使房屋毗（pí）连房屋，田地接连田地，而只让你们自己单独住在那地域内的人！

text_en: The Lord of hosts has sworn in my hearing: Surely many houses shall be desolate, large and beautiful houses, without inhabitant.
text_cn: 万军的上主在我耳边宣誓说：那许多房屋必将成为废墟；巍峨华丽的，必无人居住；

text_en: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield but one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield a mere ephah.
text_cn: 十亩葡萄园将只出一“巴特”酒，一“曷默尔”种子，只出一“厄法”谷。

text_en: Ah, you who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink, who linger in the evening to be inflamed by wine,
text_cn: 祸哉，那些早晨一起来即追求烈酒，留连至深夜，饮至酒酣耳热的人！

text_en: whose feasts consist of lyre and harp, tambourine and flute and wine, but who do not regard the deeds of the Lord , or see the work of his hands!
text_cn: 在他们的宴会上只有琴、瑟、手鼓、管笛和酒，却没有人注视上主的作为，没有人留意他手中的工作：

text_en: Therefore my people go into exile without knowledge; their nobles are dying of hunger, and their multitude is parched with thirst.
text_cn: 因此，我的百姓必因无知而被放逐，显贵必将饿得要死，民众必将渴得要命。

text_en: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth beyond measure; the nobility of Jerusalem and her multitude go down, her throng and all who exult in her.
text_cn: 为此，阴府张大了咽喉，敞开了无限的大口，显贵、群众以及那些喧哗宴乐的人，都要落在里面。

text_en: People are bowed down, everyone is brought low, and the eyes of the haughty are humbled.
text_cn: 人必将屈服，人必被抑制，目空一切的人必低首下心。

text_en: But the Lord of hosts is exalted by justice, and the Holy God shows himself holy by righteousness.
text_cn: 万军的上主必因正义而受尊崇，至圣的天主必因公平而显为圣。

text_en: Then the lambs shall graze as in their pasture, fatlings and kids shall feed among the ruins.
text_cn: 羔羊要在那里吃草，有如在自己的草场上；肥羊要在荒田里吃草。

text_en: Ah, you who drag iniquity along with cords of falsehood, who drag sin along as with cart ropes,
text_cn: 祸哉，那些用牛犊的缰绳引来邪恶，用牛车的绳索勾出罪孽的人，

text_en: who say, “Let him make haste, let him speed his work that we may see it; let the plan of the Holy One of Israel hasten to fulfillment, that we may know it! ”
text_cn: 和那些说：“愿他赶快，迅速完成他的工作，好使我们看看；愿以色列圣者的决策尽速执行，好使我们知道”的人！

text_en: Ah, you who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!
text_cn: 祸哉，那些称恶为善，称善为恶；以暗为光，以光为暗；以苦为甘，以甘为苦的人！

text_en: Ah, you who are wise in your own eyes, and shrewd in your own sight!
text_cn: 祸哉，那些自视为聪明和自以为通达的人！

text_en: Ah, you who are heroes in drinking wine and valiant at mixing drink,
text_cn: 祸哉，那些饮酒的英雄，调酒的壮士！

text_en: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, and deprive the innocent of their rights!
text_cn: 那些受贿释放罪人，夺取义人权利的人！

text_en: Therefore, as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root will become rotten, and their blossom go up like dust; for they have rejected the instruction of the Lord of hosts, and have despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 因此，他们必如卷入火舌中的禾秸，焚于烈焰中的枯草；他们的根必要糜烂，他们的嫩芽必要如尘埃般的飞扬，因为他们抛弃了万军上主的教导，藐视了以色列圣者的训诲。

text_en: Therefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against his people, and he stretched out his hand against them and struck them; the mountains quaked, and their corpses were like refuse in the streets. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
text_cn: 为此，上主向自己的百姓大发雷霆，伸出自己的手来打击他们；其时，山岳为之震撼，他们的尸体，有如街道上的粪土。然而他的震怒并未因此而熄灭，他的手仍然伸着。

text_en: He will raise a signal for a nation far away, and whistle for a people at the ends of the earth; Here they come, swiftly, speedily!
text_cn: 上主要向远方的异民竖起一面旗帜，好由大地的四极号召他们，看，他们将疾趋前来。

text_en: None of them is weary, none stumbles, none slumbers or sleeps, not a loincloth is loose, not a sandal-thong broken;
text_cn: 他们中没有疲倦的，没有仆倒的；没有打盹的，没有睡觉的；他们的腰带没有松解，他们的鞋带也没有折断；

text_en: their arrows are sharp, all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs seem like flint, and their wheels like the whirlwind.
text_cn: 他们的箭矢锐利，他们的弓弩全已张开；他们的马蹄好似火石，他们的车轮有如旋风；

text_en: Their roaring is like a lion, like young lions they roar; they growl and seize their prey, they carry it off, and no one can rescue.
text_cn: 他们怒吼有如母狮，吼叫有如幼狮；他们咆哮攫（jué）食，携之而去，无人予以挽救。

text_en: They will roar over it on that day, like the roaring of the sea. And if one look to the land— only darkness and distress; and the light grows dark with clouds.
text_cn: 那一日，他们必如海啸般向这民族怒号。人若注视大地，看，尽是黑暗痛苦；光明遮蔽在密云中，成了晦暗。
